items.title: Bind no-validator warn/skip requirement to verifier implementation
items.context: Close gap_analyze high gap for testing-infra.md:38. The verifier path must mechanically state that no validate file, no configured command, and no fallback command returns warn/skip rather than fail, while strong gates require explicit validate.command(s).

happy.desc: Inspect verifier implementation after the change -> code near the no-validation-entry path explicitly back-links to docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md:38 and states that missing validate.ts/js/mts, missing validate.command(s), and no fallback command returns warn/skip instead of failure; WHY: closes the requirement-to-code convergence gap mechanically.

edge.desc: Run the validation protocol smoke after the implementation back-link -> no-entry runtime behavior remains provider koala-verifier-no-validation-entry with status warn and allPass true; WHY: annotation/back-link must not change verifier behavior.

adversarial.desc: Review the diff for CHK-001 -> the fix is limited to requirement binding/annotation and does not relax configured validate.command(s) hard-gate behavior or fallback discovery semantics; WHY: closing coverage must not weaken validation policy.

items.userSees: 用户运行 `koala gap_analyze` 后，不再看到 testing-infra.md:38 的 no-entry warn/skip high gap；代码注释能回链到 verifier no-entry policy。

verificationEvidence.note: verifier.ts file-level @task B-9cec annotation links docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md:38 to the no-entry warn/skip policy without adding a function-level test gap.
validation protocol smoke passed after the annotation and provider change, including the no-entry provider/status/allPass assertions.

items.title: Cover no-entry warn/skip and configured hard-gate behavior in smoke tests
items.context: Validation protocol smoke should prove no-entry returns provider koala-verifier-no-validation-entry with status warn/allPass true, and configured command failure remains a hard validation failure instead of falling back.

happy.desc: Run npm --prefix packages/main run test:validation-protocol -> the no-entry fixture asserts provider koala-verifier-no-validation-entry, status warn, allPass true, and guidance that strong gates require explicit validate.command(s); WHY: proves non-TS projects without validation entrypoints are skipped/warned rather than failed.

edge.desc: Run the configured failing validation-command fixture -> configured validate.command(s) failure returns a hard validation failure with allPass false and does not fall back to discovered package scripts; WHY: explicit project gates must stay authoritative.

adversarial.desc: Exercise a project root with no validate file, no configured command, and no fallback command -> validate must not throw, must not mark the project failed, and must report warn/skip evidence; WHY: protects Python/Go/C++ or otherwise non-TS projects from false failure.
